Partner with us

Three ways to sell through MakersBridge

Begin with what you have today. Every seller and product is reviewed before going live.

I have a design

You bring the artwork and audience. We turn it into a jersey, bag, apparel piece, or collection.

  • Product blueprint and costing
  • Factory sourcing and sample approval
  • Preorder or ready-stock listing

I already have products

List approved inventory and use MakersBridge for discovery, selling, and optional fulfillment coordination.

  • Seller and product review
  • Shop listing and shoppable content
  • Optional delivery handoff

We are a university team

Create a club storefront, collect jersey preorders, and assign a student partner to coordinate the launch.

  • Team storefront and campaign page
  • Size and personalization collection
  • Campus ambassador support
